representation.name: OpenSpliceAI v0.0.5 direct predictor OSAIMANE-10000nt ensemble
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
mkdir -p deps modeldir prediction
cp "$(inputs.package.path)" openspliceai-0.0.5-py3-none-any.whl
cp "$(inputs.h5pywheel.path)" h5py-3.11.0-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl
cp "$(inputs.pyfaidxwheel.path)" pyfaidx-0.8.1.1-py3-none-any.whl
cp "$(inputs.psutilwheel.path)" psutil-5.9.8-cp36-abi3-manylinux_2_12_x86_64.manylinux2010_x86_64.manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl
cp "$(inputs.script.path)" run_predict.py
python -m pip install --no-deps --target deps openspliceai-0.0.5-py3-none-any.whl h5py-3.11.0-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl pyfaidx-0.8.1.1-py3-none-any.whl psutil-5.9.8-cp36-abi3-manylinux_2_12_x86_64.manylinux2010_x86_64.manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl
cp "$(inputs.model10.path)" modeldir/model_10000nt_rs10.pt
cp "$(inputs.model11.path)" modeldir/model_10000nt_rs11.pt
cp "$(inputs.model12.path)" modeldir/model_10000nt_rs12.pt
cp "$(inputs.model13.path)" modeldir/model_10000nt_rs13.pt
cp "$(inputs.model14.path)" modeldir/model_10000nt_rs14.pt
PYTHONPATH=deps python run_predict.py "$(inputs.sequence.path)" modeldir prediction
